notes.title: [1.1.2] Game Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Zhiyi. Thank you all for your support. Thanks to you, "Suicide Countdown: 7 Days" has successfully released the 1.1.2 version update.

The most important update in this version is the English translation. As a poor developer, I didn't have enough budget to hire a team or individual translator. Luckily, I utilized the mature AI technology to translate the game into English. During the process, I manually checked and ensured that every sentence was true to my intention. Although I believe the translation is ok enough, I am still uncertain about its quality in the eyes of native English speakers. So, I sincerely hope to receive feedback from you all. 

Additionally, the game's price in the United States has been reduced from $2.99 to $1.99(In fact, the prices have also been reduced overall in other regions.). 

I also have made the following improvements to the game:

1. Redesigned the character illustrations, for example, Fu Jing's was modified to look more like the first version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39644221/776350f36ce6babb757f0e277b75c3e2c2ac8fff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39644221/113f20c3ba6050412f41e0a56031fa20680cfa8b.png[/img]
Other characters have also been modified, so feel free to open the game and experience it for yourself.

2. Improved the backgrounds, such as the Han Chuan's home, to better match the game's atmosphere and reduce the 3D rendering feeling.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39644221/01c55ab2ed61ce5ba442883f048e71870fbdfc31.png[/img]
Other backgrounds have also been changed, so please update and experience them.

3. Player can now skip the game's cutscenes by pressing the left mouse button after just one second.

4. The game language and Steam client UI language will be automatically synchronized the first time the game is launched. If players find that the language is not in English after launching the game, they can manually change it in the Config.


I hope you have fun playing! If you encounter any problems in the game, please feel free to [url=https://twitter.com/zeii_kun]contact me.[/url]

notes.title: 【1.0.1】更新说明
notes.content:
游戏刚刚更新了1.0.1版本。
此次更新主要有如下改动：

1.流程图中月光结局的流程图节点不再显示为普通节点，而是蝴蝶形状的结局节点。
2.在设置中为卡关的玩家增加一键解锁所有锁的选项。
3.程序方面小问题的修复。

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39644221/a7c4feeb657beee9988bfcec2ad6d59f8addc0c6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39644221/f97ed1a6d2b196a80b468d3d99f0b28d42c8c731.jpg[/img][/url]

祝各位游戏愉快！
